I soaked the removable part for 20 minutes, then used a cotton swab for the corner. The main bowl rinsed easily, but the small channel did not. In a tiny sink, this daily cleanup cancels out the convenience for me.

author: 김*
title: Cracked measuring cup in the box
text: The measuring cup arrived split down the side. The cooker itself looked fine but I requested the missing usable accessory before trying it.

author: 윤*
title: Comfortable for a slow breakfast
text: Measured mine at roughly 8 cm across and 9 cm tall. Around 250 ml leaves room at the top, which is enough for my morning coffee. The handles fit two of my fingers. Used the pair daily since September 30; they feel substantial but not too heavy when full.

author: j___m
title: Three washes, still pleased
text: 손으로 세 번 씻었어요. No marks after coffee and barley tea, as long as I rinse them the same morning. The bases sit flat on our wooden tray. I bought the pair because one was never enough when a friend visits. These are my first impressions after a week.

title: Another pair for the office
text: Second purchase on October 14. My first pair has been at home since August, and both handles are still secure. I use them for filter coffee, not a large latte. The cardboard dividers kept the new pair from knocking together in the parcel.

author: counterspace
title: Useful pockets, comfortable for a long cook
text: I am 164 cm and the hem falls just above my knees after adjusting the neck strap. The front pocket holds a dish towel and my phone without pulling forward too much. Cooked two batches of kimchi pancakes on October 12; the fabric kept the flour off my clothes. The neck strap did not rub.

title: Light cups for a small breakfast

author: 이*
title: 충전선이 너무 짧아요
text: 동봉된 선이 짧아서 책상 아래 콘센트까지 안 닿아요. 집에 있던 긴 선으로 바꿔 썼습니다. 연결은 잘 되는데 기본 선 길이는 아쉽네요.
